headline: Lewiston School Committee reviewed personnel hires, transfers, resignations, and retirements on a consent agenda; no public input was given.
summary: The committee reviewed a consent agenda listing new hires, transfers, resignations, and one retirement for certified staff, coaches, educational technicians, management, and support employees across district schools. No public input was offered, and the meeting adjourned.
